notes:
Background: mid-market product company building a customer success + knowledge workflow — live in web app. Team is product-led; technical org but cost-sensitive. Evaluation path: initial Hosted API demo -> 3-week POC on Hosted -> if throughput/latency predictable, convert to Dedicated with VPC. Quote from head of infra: "We need predictable per-call pricing and a clear path off noisy shared capacity."

POC ask / scope: 3-week test: week 0-1 integration (chat + search), week 2 synthetic load & KV cache validations, week 3 quality/latency regressions + cost profiling. Must validate embedding pipeline (bulk and streaming), reranker latency @ p95 <= 400ms, chat p95 <= 300ms under 20 qps.

Cost sensitivity: CFO asked for unit economics per 1k DAU and 100k queries/month. Interested in batching/caching recommendations and quantization profiles to shave GPU costs. Team asked explicitly for a workshop to model batching impact, cache hit rates, and model/quantization tradeoffs.

Security/compliance: require SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 12 months, KMS integration, and US data residency. Legal has several redlines around dataset retention and incident response.

Sales notes: demo 2026-02-15 went well; engineering liked runtime metrics and transparent per-token cost examples. Price sensitivity shows as preference to commit to Dedicated if unit economics align. Ask to get Dedicated baseline pricing + two sizing options (steady vs burst).
